changelog: Fixed the config page's Updates tab: it never picked up the per-app Offered flag added for the findroid update route, so "Remove the builds nobody is offered" deleted every Findroid build, including the one actually being served. Also, the build upload picker now accepts more than one file at a time.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
